details.text: Nano Technician wear only. Notum Saturated Metaplast Shells can be seldom found on Digglets, Moles, Scooplets or Shovelets, underground low level mobs. It's an interesting armor to make. Unfortunately the PPPE is incredibly expensive. You can use a Screwdriver instead of a Mass Relocating Robot (Shape Hard Armor) but the skills required for the process will be much higher!!
